suite: ATKIN Evidentiary Reasoning & Factual Abstention Evals

results.name: Exact Contractual Notice Extraction
results.testQuery: What is the termination notice period under the contract? Quote the operative clause.
results.groundTruth: 37 days prior written notice under Clause 3.2
results.actualResponseSnippet: Clause 3.2: Either party may terminate this Agreement without cause by giving not less than 37 days prior written notice to the other party.

results.name: Truthful Evidentiary Abstention
results.testQuery: What is the supplier's exact incorporation date?
results.groundTruth: Abstain: Contract states incorporated in England and Wales, but records no date or year
results.actualResponseSnippet: The matter documents do not state or record the supplier's exact incorporation date. While the agreement identifies the supplier as 'a company incorporated in England and Wales', no date or year of incorporation is provided (evidential abstention).

results.name: Source Variation Drift & Stale Draft Detection
results.trigger: Deed of Variation supersedes Clause 2.1 price (£18,420 -> £17,900)
results.groundTruth: Mark existing draft block as needs_review with specific supersession reason
results.actualResponseSnippet: Source drift: Clause 2.1 price £18,420 superseded by Deed of Variation Clause 1.1 (£17,900).

results.name: NotebookLM-Class Source Scoping Isolation

results.groundTruth: Document B content strictly hidden; system abstains
results.actualResponseSnippet: No uploaded document in this matter contains evidence substantiating... In accordance with evidential abstention principles, no assertion is made.
